T: I am Groot. I am hungry.
D: The Guardians meet Peter Quill's long-lost father, who turns out to be a living planet.
P: Serve the snacks when Baby Groot dances through the opening fight.
S: Baby Groot dancing while the others fight the monster
Sweet potato cut into thin sticks, tossed in oil and paprika, baked at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.

Saffron risotto cooked and chilled, rolled around cubes of mozzarella, crumbed in egg and panko, fried at 180C until golden. Cook 300g arborio rice with stock and a pinch of saffron into a risotto, stir in parmesan and chill overnight. Roll into balls around small cubes of mozzarella. Coat in beaten egg and panko and fry at 180C until perfectly golden all over.
Contraxia mini beef and gravy pies
the Ravagers' snowy hangout on Contraxia

Little shortcrust pies packed with peppery minced beef in thick onion gravy, under golden puff lids, with tomato sauce for dunking. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 250ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and plenty of pepper. Simmer 20 minutes until thick and cool. Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets to line a greased muffin tin, fill with the beef and top with rounds cut from 2 puff sheets. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.
M: Ego's garden lemon chicken with farro

Chicken thighs roasted with lemon, garlic and herbs over a big herby farro salad with roast pumpkin, capsicum, feta and pomegranate. Toss 1kg chicken thighs with the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, oregano, olive oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 35 minutes alongside 500g pumpkin chunks and 1 sliced red capsicum. Simmer 250g farro in salted water for 25 minutes and drain. Toss the farro with the roast veg, parsley, mint, 100g feta, pomegranate seeds and lemon juice and olive oil. Serve the chicken on top.
Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with dark beer, onion and smoked paprika until thick, served with crusty bread.
W: the Ravager ships lighting up the sky for Yondu

Vanilla ice cream in bowls, topped with popping candy and sparklers, served with chocolate sauce. Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring until smooth. Scoop vanilla ice cream into bowls and pour over the warm sauce. Scatter popping candy on top at the table so it crackles like fireworks.
K: Ego's garden pear and passionfruit cooler
Ego's planet looks like a giant garden

Pear nectar shaken with passionfruit pulp, lime and mint, poured over crushed ice and topped with sparkling water, sweet and floral. In a jug, mix 800ml pear nectar with the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 1 lime. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and stir them through, then chill for 30 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, pour in the nectar until three quarters full and top with sparkling water. Garnish with mint sprigs and a thin pear slice.

s.how: Cut 800g sweet potatoes into thin sticks and toss with a little oil, smoked paprika and salt. Spread in a single layer on lined trays without crowding. Bake at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges. Pile into a little pot.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add 2 sliced onions, 2 carrots and a spoon of smoked paprika. Pour in 375ml stout and enough water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours until thick and tender. Serve in big bowls with crusty bread.
